title: The Search
hook: Rumi crossed the mountains to Damascus, looking for one man.

segments.fa: ما عاشق و سرگشته و شیدای دمشقیم
segments.en: We are lovers, lost and mad for Damascus.

segments.fa: جان داده و دل بسته سودای دمشقیم
segments.en: We gave our soul. Our heart is bound to the longing for Damascus.

tafsir: Shams had vanished. Word said he might be in Damascus.
So Rumi went himself, and searched the city.
His son, Sultan Walad, wrote what happened next.
Rumi stopped searching. He found Shams within himself.
From then on, he put Shams's name on his poems.

outro.say: Part eight. How did the Masnavi begin? Follow The Guest House.
outro.title: Part 8 · The Masnavi begins
